descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Mission 
 The project focuses on building, modernizing, and continuously improving a large-scale GCP cloud platform supporting business-critical applications across E-commerce, Software Engineering, and Data & AI. Key areas include enhancing GCP infrastructure and landing zones, managing and optimizing GKE/Kubernetes and Cloud Run environments, automating infrastructure with Terraform, and improving GitLab CI/CD pipelines. A strong emphasis is placed on cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, security, GitOps, and observability, ensuring a secure, scalable, and reliable cloud ecosystem. This is a hands-on engineering project focused on platform evolution, automation, and architectural improvements, rather than traditional cloud maintenance and operations.
 What you'll do 
Building, operating and further developing the product team-owned infrastructure on the GCP platform
Implement and maintain infrastructure with Terraform (using centrally managed modules and pipelines)
Building and Operating CI/CD Pipelines for Applications (GitLab CI/CD)
Integration and use of core platform components (e.g., logging, secrets, IAM, VPC, DNS)
Application of secure defaults (IAM, secrets, network, TLS, policies)
Support in day-to-day operations (e.g. incident response, infrastructure maintenance, performance analysis)
Collaborate with all other platform teams (e.g., to use/improve shared Terraform modules and policies)
 What you need to be successful 
Our main Tech stack is Google Cloud Platform (GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, DNS, Secret Manager), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps (Flux),Flagger, Observability (Datadog or GCP Monitoring)
GCP landing zone expertise: Talent has in the past set up a GCP or AWS landing zone (or reworked, extended on)
Kubernetes on GCP and AWS: Talent has configured, managed and improved GKE or EKS setups
Cloud Run and Cloud Functions: Talent knows cloud-native options as well as related challenges & chances
Secret and credential management: Talent has integrated Google Cloud Secret Manager (or AWS Secret Manager) in a bigger company / mid-to-large-scale-company setup
Cloud Network: Talent has either set up or reworked a Cloud network (GCP and/or AWS)
Artifact Registry: Talent has implemented Google Artifact Registry or AWS CodeArtifact in a bigger company / mid-to-large-scale-company setup
GitLab: Talent knows a cross-environment GitLab runner setup. Talent migrated use cases to GitLab component (or GitHub actions).
Terraform: Experience in the productive use of Terraform (modular repositories, environments, Plan/Apply in CI/CD)
 Nice to have 
Management of Kubernetes resources (e.g. deployments, RBAC, network, policies, upgrades) and Helm releases
